steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ use the -ing list — enjoy, hate, keep, avoid, miss, regret, give up + -ing
✓ use the to list — want, decide, choose, hope, plan, learn, promise, refuse + to
✓ use -ing after a preposition — instead of looking , good at playing
✓ tell the three pairs apart — stop , remember , try + -ing or + to
✓ talk about life decisions — change career, take up, retire, leave home, get married
✓ tell a life story in the past recycled — he decided to teach , she began studying
